messages:
alyssa: Heads-up, CI on macOS went red after the toolchain roll last night. Multiple builds failing with undefined refs and a missing header. Can someone take a quick look?

ben: Noticed too. Failing target is //runtime/io:io_test on darwin-fast. Error looks like linker + missing include from stdlib.

alyssa: Paste of the top of the error:```ld: symbol(s) not found for architecture x86_64
Undefined symbols for architecture x86_64:
  "__ZN3io6Reader10read_exactEPcm", referenced from:...
clang: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)
In file included from /workspace/runtime/io/io.cpp:12:
/usr/include/c++/v1/iostream:39:10: fatal error: 'bits/c++config.h' file not found
```

kai: Could be ccache / sysroot mismatch after the toolchain image bump. Try `bazel clean --expunge` and build with `--action_env=MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=11.0` to help reproduce locally.

ben: I can reproduce on my mac runner. Quick bisect idea: suspect the toolchain packaging change in the image that moved libc++ headers. @ops-oncall can you kick a hermetic rerun with the previous toolchain image tag to confirm?

ops-oncall: @ci-bot scheduled a rerun with TOOLCHAIN_TAG=toolchain-2026-02-14 on darwin-fast for //runtime/io:io_test. Job: https://ci.redwood.test/12345 (running) :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

ci-bot: Re-run started by ops-oncall. Using bazel cache key 2026-03-toolchain-roll-bisect.

alyssa: If rerun with old image is green that narrows it. If it fails, then maybe the change is in the repo. Also please grab `bazel build --spawn_strategy=local --verbose_failures` output if it still fails.

ben: Rerun with old image is green. So it's the toolchain image. I diffed the two images and noticed headers in /opt/toolchain/include/libc++ moved to /opt/toolchain/usr/include/libc++ in the new image. Build is picking up system include paths first.

kai: Nice find. Short-term: revert the packaging change on the image or add a symlink in the image. Long-term: we should pin include paths in our sandboxed toolchain definition.

ben: Created roll-back PR for the toolchain image: https://git.redwood/infrateam/toolchain/commit/ab12cd34 — requesting review from infra image owners.

ops-oncall: CI rerun on the new image after adding a symlink fix also turned green. I'm going to mark the incident resolved. :white_check_mark: 

alyssa: Thanks team. For follow-up: kai, can you file a tiny ticket to pin include paths in bazel toolchain or add a sanity check in CI that compares include dirs between images?

kai: Will do. Filing ticket: https://issues.redwood/INFRA-987 (short description: "Toolchain image include path sanity check")

ben: Reassigning to infra-image for long-term. Closing the slack thread. :slightly_smiling_face:
